verdict.rationale: Free wildcard SSL bundled with domains is clearly documented (porkbun-docs-11/26/29), satisfying half the story, but the evidence only shows a paid 'Porkbun email hosting' product (porkbun-docs-12) rather than a free email-forwarding feature bundled at no extra cost. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that email forwarding is free/included (not a paid hosting add-on), and independent confirmation of the bundled cost claim.
